gloss: to conclude; to bring to completion; to be complete in itself

definitions.gloss: to conclude; to reach completion; to come to an end (of a series, story, or project)
definitions.explanation: For a work, series, or process to reach its natural and intended conclusion.

definitions.gloss: to be complete in itself; to be self-contained
definitions.explanation: For something to form a complete whole without requiring anything additional.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧30{巻|かん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{完結|かんけつ}した。
⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{完結|かんけつ}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the serialization reaching its conclusion.

examples.english: It is complete in this single volume.

examples.english: Though this story is a short piece, it is admirably self-contained.

notes:
Especially common in discussions of manga, anime, novels, and TV series. ⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧ emphasizes that something has reached its proper, intended ending — not just stopped, but concluded with finality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: already concluded
- {一話|いちわ}⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧: self-contained per episode
- ⟦{完結|かんけつ}{編|へん}→完結編：20712_kanketsuhen⟧: concluding arc/volume
- ⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧{巻|かん}: final volume
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧X{巻|かん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧: concluded in X volumes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完了|かんりょう}する→完了する：20676_kanryousuru⟧: to complete — more procedural, used for tasks and processes
- ⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}する→終了する：22990_shuuryousuru⟧: to end — simply stopping, without the nuance of a satisfying conclusion
- ⟦{終結|しゅうけつ}→終結：13851_shuuketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to come to an end — used for conflicts, disputes, or negotiations
